## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      17 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 22 jul 2026 - 7 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Tomito6_, 2 oct 2026, 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
            2. _A136P_, 24 sept 2026, 1/5: "I was using this app for over a year and really liked it. At some point that had a huge system update and since then it would glitch constantly and lag. I have ended up deleting it as a result"
            3. _AverageMean_, 13 sept 2026, 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
